comment: All candidates shared Adam and nominal displacement 0.0768, so architecture decided the ranking. K1006 and K1008 supported C: two normalized blocks with ReLU beat the less-normalized SiLU alternatives. K1022 weakly supported E’s later normalization, but could not directly settle E versus D because their residual status differed. D’s extra depth plausibly helped relative to B, while A’s unnormalized plain stack was least favorable at this budget. K1076 was supporting context, not a complete ordering rule. The gold confirms this recipe ordering, but does not isolate a new general effect.
